subcategory_text: Remote maintenance of organizational assets is approved, logged, and performed in a manner that prevents unauthorized access.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: MA-4 (Nonlocal Maintenance), MA-2
implementation_examples: Approve, log, and perform remote maintenance with controls that prevent unauthorised access (e.g., out-of-band approvals, session recording, time-bound credentials)
Treat remote maintenance connections as privileged access
assessment_objectives: Determine whether remote maintenance is approved and logged
Determine whether the session uses controls to prevent unauthorised access
Determine whether maintenance is treated as privileged access
Determine whether credentials are refreshed on completion
